name: Flexible descriptions
description: Manage field descriptions across content entity types/bundles from a central admin UI, with per-bundle permissions and optional translation.
project_description:
This module is designed to streamline field descriptions for all entity types effortlessly. It simplifies the way you handle field descriptions by storing them as content entities, ensuring a seamless experience even when the content editor makes edits.

 Whether you're a content editor, site administrator, or developer, Flexible Descriptions is your go-to solution for enhancing the way you handle field descriptions across your Drupal site.

 Within this solution - the descriptions become more content, than configs.

 Features 
 - Simplified descriptions management: control all the field descriptions within one form

- YAML Import/export mechanism

- Not only users with the "administer content" permission could manage field descriptions

- No need to import/export configs each time you want to edit the field description (so cannot be overwritten during deployments)

- Dynamic permissions behavior to handle descriptions management access per each entity bundle

 2.0.0 release
- Added inline creation/editing functionality using the HTMX library
- Added translation support
